title: Complete Simplicial Complex Infrastructure for Gowers Hypergraph Regularity

problemStatement.formal: Define SimplicialComplex (nested family of j-graphs) and relative density for the full Gowers (2007) regularity, building on UHypergraph from SzemerediHypergraphCore.lean
problemStatement.plain: The existing SzemerediHypergraphCore.lean defines naive hypergraph regularity, insufficient for the multidimensional Szemerédi theorem. Define the Gowers (2007) regularity infrastructure: SimplicialComplex, relativeKDensity, and IsGowersRegular.
whyMatters: Prerequisite for hypergraph counting lemma (Nagle-Rödl-Schacht 2006) and multidimensional Szemerédi
Extends existing UHypergraph infrastructure with correct regularity notion
Would centralize 27+ scattered hypergraph definitions across Erdős problem files

proven: UHypergraph V k: k-uniform hypergraph structure (SzemerediHypergraphCore.lean, 0 sorries)
kPartiteDensity: k-graph density in k-partite setting
open: SimplicialComplex V k: nested family of j-graphs for j < k with down-closure
relativeKDensity H C: k-graph density relative to a simplicial complex
IsGowersRegular H ε C: full Gowers regularity predicate
knownResults.goal: Define SimplicialComplex, relativeKDensity, IsGowersRegular and prove naive_implies_gowers: IsHypergraphRegular → IsGowersRegular (complete complex)

currentState.focus: Define simplicial complex infrastructure extending SzemerediHypergraphCore.lean
